annotations.title: Regime + One-Per-Family Read for One Ticker — SML REGIME SCAN

description: SML REGIME SCAN single ticker (PAID $0.02 USDC on Base via x402). Same engine as regime_scan_board for any one US stock or ETF, on the board or not: regime, all 8 family readings with their vote, setup (or why there is none), score, the checks that passed and the ones missing, trigger / invalidation / next level, the setup type's measured history and the live price vs levels. Starts with a one-sentence `answer`. Use for: checking one ticker against the regime-first, one-per-family stack. Don't use when: you need raw OHLC, intraday bars, crypto spot, or execution. Not financial advice.

payment_tx_hash.description: Base USDC tx hash (sovereign rail) paying the tool price to the canonical SML receiver.
